description: 献给至今没有非洲之心的群友，以及实装该道具后第一把就出了的制作者。放进法杖：法杖伤害 +{amount}，不带属性，哪把法杖都能装，永不耗尽。

descriptions.en: For the guild friends still waiting on their Heart of Africa, and for the maker who pulled it on the very first run after adding it. Set in a staff: staff Damage +{amount}, no element, fits any staff, and never runs out.
